sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B for Local AI in 2026: Which GPU Runs It and What Speed to ...
sources.snippet: TL;DR: Qwen3.6-27B is a dense 27B model released April 22, 2026 that scores 77.2 on SWE-bench Verified — beating Alibaba's own 397B MoE on coding benchmarks. At Q4_K_M it needs 16.8 GB of VRAM. An RTX 3090 runs it at ~40 tok/s; an RTX 4090 reaches ~70 tok/s. The 16 GB cards (RTX 5060 Ti, RTX 4080) can run it, but at constrained context windows.
